summary: The test 'test_toggleable_failure' failed because the environment variable 'TOGGLE_TEST_FAILURE' was set to 'true', which triggers an intentional failure for demo purposes.
likely_root_cause: The CI/CD environment or Jenkins pipeline has the environment variable 'TOGGLE_TEST_FAILURE' configured to 'true', triggering the pytest.fail() call at line 114 in 'tests/test_logic.py'.
suggested_fix: Change the environment variable 'TOGGLE_TEST_FAILURE' to 'false' or remove it from the CI/CD pipeline configuration / Jenkins environment settings.
